title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.306 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.306 ## 0.3.305 - Added `recommendations` and `fix` to the `get_usage` response's behavior windows - Fixed servers set with `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from the user's own settings - Fixed `startup()` with `initializeTimeoutMs: null` counting time spent in SessionStart or Setup hooks against its 60-second limit; `null` now works like leaving the option out - Changed the `startup()` and `prewarm()` timeout error for a start with no open SessionStart or Setup hook: it lists possible causes and no longer says to check authentication and network - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.305 ## 0.3.304
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
